title: release-cutover-checklist-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-17-ava
content:
Context: daily cutover for 2026-03-17. small rollback patch + backports for tokenization regression (ENG-4827) and autoscaler tweak (ENG-4831). This is my personal scratchpad - high-level steps, devnotes, quick checks.

Owners / comms
- Release lead: Ava Patel (me)
- Infra on-call: Jordan Lee (pager)
- SRE / rollout support: Samir Khan
- Notify: #releases, #infra-oncall, production-support@redwood.com
- Exec FYI (if degraded > 15m): @Elena

Timeline (PT)
- 09:00 - pre-cutover sync (15m) - confirm infra health + DB replicas caught up
- 09:20 - start canary (10%) - deploy platform patch to canary hostpool
- 09:40 - monitor 20m - watch p50/p95 latency and error-rate on API and stream endpoints
- 10:00 - ramp to 50% (if stable)
- 10:30 - full traffic switch + run smoke tests
- 11:00 - post-deploy validation + cutoff for rollback window

Pre-cutover checklist (must be green)
- [ ] Confirm DB migrations have roll-forward/back plans (no downtime): migration ENG-4827m has backout script (tested locally)
- [x] Feature flags identified: tokenization-hotfix-2026-03-17 (FF: off -> on during cutover)
- [ ] Backports queued: PRs #2743 (platform), #2746 (autoscaler) - need LGTMs from @samir
- [x] Smoke test script updated (scripts/smoke/cutover-2026-03-17.sh)
- [ ] Dashboards linked and pinned: platform/latency, api/errors, autoscaler/events
- [x] Canary hostpool reserved: canary-08 set (2 GPUs)

Backport / PR list
- platform patch: PR #2743 - contains tokenization fix (backport to release-1.8.2) - reviewer: Samir Khan (requested)
- autoscaler tweak: PR #2746 - small change to downscale threshold (target release-1.8.x)
- engineering note: need to cherry-pick both into release-1.8.2 and create a combined release candidate tag rc-1.8.2-20260317

Deployment commands (quick copy)
- deploy canary: ./scripts/deploy --env=prod --pool=canary-08 --tag=rc-1.8.2-20260317 --subset=10
- promote to 50%: ./deploy-promote --to=50 --route=api-v1
- full promote: ./deploy-promote --to=100 --route=api-v1 && notify slack
- rollback (if >5% errors for >5m): ./deploy-rollback --tag=previous-stable && run rollback-db.sh

Post-deploy verification
- [ ] Run smoke tests: scripts/smoke/cutover-2026-03-17.sh -> expect all pass
- [ ] Verify KV cache hit-rate remains >= 70%
- [ ] Check p95 latency < 350ms across public endpoints (dashboards: platform/latency)
- [ ] Check error-rate < 0.5% on api/errors
- [ ] Confirm autoscaler behaves (no unexpected scaledowns) - watch autoscaler/events
- [ ] Run sample inference on canary model: prompt -> check tokenization outputs for regression case

Monitoring / alerts to watch
- Alert: API Error Rate > 0.5% (pager)
- Alert: Request Latency p95 > 500ms (pager)
- Alert: Autoscaler failed scale action (non-pager initially)
- Dashboards to watch: platform/latency, api/errors, infra/gpu-util, autoscaler/events, ingestion/queue-lag

Escalation path
- 0-5m degradation: Infra oncall (Jordan) investigates, keep release lead updated
- 5-15m unresolved: bring SRE + Eng of owning service (Samir)
- >15m: Exec FYI and consider rollback

Open questions / loose ends
- Who will run the migration backout if migration ENG-4827 fails post-promote? (need explicit volunteer)
- Need final LGTM on PR #2746 from product before full promote
- Confirm backup snapshot time and retention (ask DB team to confirm latest snapshot at 08:45 PT)

Comms templates
- Slack (canary start): "Starting canary deploy for rc-1.8.2-20260317 -> 10% on canary-08. Ping @infra-oncall for immediate issues."
- Slack (full promote): "Promoting rc-1.8.2-20260317 to 100% for api-v1. Watch platform/latency and api/errors. Contact @Ava if anything spikes."
- Incident template (if rollback): short summary, timeline, root cause hypothesis, steps taken, follow-up action items

Notes to self:
- Keep the rollback window open until 11:15 PT (extra 15m for slow failure modes)
- If autoscaler behaves oddly during 50% ramp, pause and open detailed trace (trace id prefix: promo-20260317)
- After cutover, create short post-deploy note in Confluence and flag any flaky checks for tech debt ticket

Quick links (for copy/paste)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2743
- JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-4827
- Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/123456789/Release+Cutover+Runbook

-- Ava
